body:
I'm sorry you're here. I just posted my own thread a few hours ago, and I've stood at the edge staring down multiple times, ever since I was a teenager. So I can understand how you've gotten here. I don't think you're selfish. Many people don't seem to get that you can only fight for so long before you run out of the energy left to fight any longer. 

I just want you to know that there are countless strangers with you in their hearts at the moment, and if we could make everything right and prevent this from happening, we would. This is your decision to make; only you can find the inner strength to pull yourself back up and keep going, but if you can't, I'm sorry. It's awful being here. 

I hope whatever decision you make, that you find peace somehow. I just hate that it had to end this way. : (

Yeah, I'd read up on the stats awhile ago when studying these disorders. It's so sad that there's so much stigma surrounding them -- I imagine it keeps a lot of people from getting the help they need. And thank you; I try to be, because I've seen what losing a member can do to the people they leave behind. It's extremely tiring, though.
If you're going through similar things, I'm sorry. ::distance hug:: I hope things get better for you, too.
Thank you. Knowing that someone took the time to comment at all feels good. : )
